tries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: landscape industrial-design concept sheet for a Blender artist, sheet 1 of a coordinated 3-sheet fictional AONAGI 2003 Japanese office lift catalogue, for Seal the Deal.
Primary request: paint completely NEW finished elevator landing designs in the same soft pearl-white, frosted-aqua and brushed-silver product-design family as the supplied approved AONAGI prop sheets. The supplied lift captures explain use and proportions only, NOT edit targets. Do not reproduce blockout captures. Use the approved furniture sheets as style references and the approved bright white office room as architectural context.
Canvas: largest high-resolution 16:9 landscape available, ideally 2400 x 1350. Clean white-to-very-pale-aqua studio background, navy clean sans-serif headings, slim aqua rule and rounded pale-aqua section headers. Finished polished industrial-design illustration / believable 3D product render, soft studio shadows, confident broad highlight rolls, no clutter. Clear coherent editorial grid, readable generous callouts. Small fictional open aqua ring with a red dot in its lower-right gap beside AONAGI at top left; no real brand or model names.
Header: "AONAGI" and "SHEET 01 / LANDINGS", small "LIFT / AERO 2003".
Composition:
LEFT about 45%: large three-quarter hero of the full-storey 1F landing wall and CLOSED two-leaf doors. Full wall visible from floor to top, 4.00 m W x 0.24 m D x 4.50 m H, centred clear opening precisely 1.40 m W x 2.20 m H. Visibly broad wall shoulders around a conventionally narrow lift portal; the doorway occupies only 35% of wall width and just under half wall height. Soft pearl panelling, two very restrained tall panel joints. Thick-looking rolled silver softly radiused portal edges, 80 mm visible face width, rounded OUTSIDE corners R60, small INNER edge round R8 preserving a full rectangular clear aperture. No arch cutting away opening. A thin silver threshold. Smoked capsule indicator above at exactly 2.66 m centre height, width720 mm x height180 mm, silver softly rolled bezel; bright cyan dot-matrix "1F" with upward arrow. One compact 90 x 230 mm brushed-silver call panel to viewer LEFT of doorway, panel centre x=-980 mm, z=1120 mm, two round cyan-ring arrow buttons. Tiny fictional AONAGI logo printed on pearl wall, subdued, no giant signage. Brushed silver door faces softly pillowed by shallow reflection, meeting at centre with fine aqua meeting-line label. Doors precisely two 0.75 m W x 2.25 m H x 0.04 m D leaves with 50 mm overlap behind each jamb. No door handles.
CENTRE upper about 28%: smaller matching front three-quarter view of SAME 1F wall HALF-OPEN, revealing silver car interior and a frosted ceiling inside. The two doors are partway slid horizontally into the wall pockets. Caption "HALF-OPEN / SAME PAIR". Tiny diagram under view: left/right arrows indicating each leaf's FULL travel 0.75 m, total clear opening 1.40 m. Keep full-storey width/height proportions identical to closed version. Do not add a third leaf or swing doors.
RIGHT upper about 27%: matching front three-quarter RF landing variant, same 4.00 x 0.24 x 4.50 m wall envelope and same clear opening. Smoked indicator reads cyan "RF", one downward arrow call button in same silver panel, modest weather lip incorporated into portal top; no redesign of doorway or giant signage. Caption "RF / ROOF LANDING". Roof canopy belongs to sheet03; keep this a matching landing variant in studio.
LOWER centre/right: two generous magnified product detail cards. Call panel: silver pillowy capsule with TWO circular buttons, upper up arrow and lower down arrow, cyan ring, clear believable shadow/recess. Indicator: rounded silver bezel smoked dark navy glass, cyan dot-matrix "1F ↑", no modern touch screen. Include small FRONT dimension elevation of wall and portal near bottom left showing 4.00 m overall width, 4.50 m height, 1.40 x 2.20 m clear opening. Keep details large enough to read.
3–5 short leader callouts for main hero: "R60 rolled-silver portal", "Smoked dot-matrix / centre 2.66 m", "Round cyan-ring call buttons", "Brushed-silver leaves / 50 mm jamb overlap", "Pearl shell / fine seams as texture".
Panel captions and critical sizes must be correct. Footer exact: "LEAF 0.75 x 0.04 x 2.25 m   |   TRAVEL 0.75 m EACH   |   DIMENSIONS GOVERN PERSPECTIVE".
Materials palette: pearl #F4F8F8 glossy moulded radiused forms; silver #C8D2D9 hairline brushed; sparse chrome highlight; aqua #45BFC7; frosted aqua #C6E9E6 / #8FDCE0; mist #A8BFD1; navy #111B38 smoked glazing; cobalt #244FB9 tiny optional print; hanko red #C7473E ONLY the fictional logo dot. Subtle frosted aqua indicator bezel edge possible, no aqua wall flood.
Constraints: finished precision 2003 Japanese corporate product design, portals and indicators immediately readable in a fast shooter, all parts fit fixed wall depth240 mm and opening1400 x2200. New surface design only, no mechanism invention. Short bilingual labels only on actual controls; if used exact "呼出 / CALL" and "屋上 / ROOF". No bubble graphics, plants, people, real brands, exposed cables, vaporwave, greebles, excessive neon, dirt, pink, red controls, extra scenes or busy room background.
references: User attachments: lift_views and lift_pieces for existing form/use; approved props sheets 6/2/5 and concept_L1_A for style only

Three-wall rounded silver handrail Ø40 at height0.95m, gentle return bends; side rails stop before controlpanel nearfront. RIGHT TOP35–40% generous operatingpanel DETAIL rendered square-on as product. Brushed silver slim pillowy plate750mmH x240mmW, round cornersR25. Small smoked cyan-floor display at top "1F". EXACTLY THREE floor call rows with round physical pearl button, cyan ring and clear labels "1F", "2F", "RF" (one of each, no other floor names). Two smaller round physical buttons beneath for opening and closing, symbols arrows facing apart / together, exact bilingual labels beneath or beside: "開 / OPEN" and "閉 / CLOSE". Small printed open aqua ring with red lower-rightgap dot and tiny AONAGI at platebottom. No keypad, no modern full-screen UI, no alarm/emergency buttons, no red button. Caption "CAR OPERATING PANEL", note "240 x 750 mm / Ø36 floor buttons".
RIGHT BOTTOM: reverse interior view toward the same CLOSED landing doors WHILE DOCKED, through the car's openfront; see back faces of the two brushed-silver leaves, silverportal, cyan fine meetingline. Narrow1.40x2.20m aperture centred in widecar3.70m. Caption "DOORS FROM INSIDE / DOCKED" and one leader "Reverse of landing pair / no extra leaves". No secondary car doors and no additional motorhardware.
LOWER LEFT belowhero: small dimensioned top/side section view, labelled3.70m OUTSIDE WIDTH,3.55m OUTSIDE DEPTH,2.60m CLEAR INSIDE HEIGHT. Distinguish100mm shellwalls and60mm floor/ceilingshell if space. Centre small rail detail with Ø40 roundedrail andR90 corner. Do not duplicate or truncate the major hero.
Footer exact "CAR 3.70 x 3.55 m OUTSIDE PLAN  |  2.60 m CLEAR INSIDE  |  DIMENSIONS GOVERN PERSPECTIVE".

tries.purpose: Original shaft and head-house concept sheet
tries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: landscape industrial-design concept sheet for a Blender artist, sheet 3 of the coordinated fictional AONAGI 2003 Japanese corporate lift catalogue for Seal the Deal.
Primary request: completely NEW finished modular lift shaft and roof head-house designs, matching the supplied approved AONAGI props / bright pearl-and-aqua office room, and the preceding two lift sheets. Supplied lift captures are size and placement references ONLY, not edit targets.
Canvas: largest high-resolution 16:9 landscape, ideally 2400 x 1350. White-to-very-pale-aqua studio backdrop, restrained broad highlights, soft shadows, navy sans-serif headings, aqua rule and pale-aqua rounded section headers. Precision industrial-design renderings with small dimension drawings.
Header: "AONAGI", small fictional aqua open ring with a red dot in its lower-right gap, "LIFT / AERO 2003", and "SHEET 03 / SHAFT + HEAD-HOUSE".
Fixed sizes: ONE shaft cell 4.00 x 4.00 m outside plan; wall build-up 100 mm, clear well 3.80 x 3.80 m. Each storey 4.50 m. Stops at 0, 4.50, 9.00 m = 1F, 2F, RF. Travel 9.00 m. Car outside plan 3.70 x 3.55 m with 2.60 m CLEAR inside height; its side and rear walls are opaque. Landing wall 4.00 W x 0.24 D x 4.50 H m, opening 1.40 W x 2.20 H m, indicator centre 2.66 m above landing, same two silver leaves 0.75 W x 0.04 D x 2.25 H m, each sliding 0.75 m.
LEFT 45%: large three-quarter hero of GLASS SHAFT ON 2F, whole 4 x 4 m cell, 4.50 m tall. View from BACK/SIDE: two near facades are glass side and rear, entry facade on far side. Slim brushed-silver rounded corner posts, 100 x 100 mm, inside outside footprint. Top/bottom rails 75 mm tall. ONE slim 30 mm centre vertical mullion per 4 m glass wall. Nearly clear glazing with subtle aqua edges/reflections and 100 mm high frosted lower ribbon. See the actual OPAQUE SILVER CAR SHELL through glass; car shorter than the 4.50 m shaft storey, car floor at this landing. Car walls are NOT transparent, show closed silver side and rear skins, pearl ceiling edge, no exposed hoist mechanism. Caption "2F / GLASS SHAFT", "4.00 x 4.00 m cell / 4.50 m storey".
Four leaders: "100 mm silver corner posts"; "Clear glass / aqua edge"; "Opaque car visible through glass"; "Frosted lower ribbon / 100 mm".
CENTRE upper 27%: standalone opaque 1F side/rear wall, 4.00 W x 0.10 D x 4.50 H m. Soft pearl cladding, R20 exposed edges, thin inset silver base and top trim, two fine vertical seams. NO DOORWAY in this side/rear wall. Caption "1F / OPAQUE WALL", "4.00 x 0.10 x 4.50 m". Leaders "Pearl cladding / R20 edges", "Fine seams = texture". Make a finished precision product with highlights, not raw blockout.
RIGHT upper 28%: entire roof HEAD-HOUSE, three-quarter, on a small empty roof patch. 4.00 x 4.00 m footprint, 4.50 m total height measured from roof to TOP of cap. Front has matching RF landing: pearl wall, rolled silver portal, two closed brushed silver leaves, 1.40 x 2.20 m clear opening centred low in 4 m wall, cyan RF smoked capsule display at 2.66 m, one cyan-ring down call button at left. Rounded pearl side cladding and restrained silver trim. Distinct softly crowned CAP / CANOPY at top, 140 mm tall, R40 outer edges, above 30 mm dark shadow reveal. Cap stays WITHIN 4.00 x 4.00 m plan; NO overhang outside cell. Shallow portal weather lip within 240 mm front wall. Caption "RF / ROOF HEAD-HOUSE", "4.00 x 4.00 x 4.50 m / CAP INCLUDED". No extra rooftop props, giant hatch, fans, additional doors or external structure.
LOWER LEFT: small dimensioned SHAFT PLAN, 4.00 m outside, 3.80 m clear, car 3.70 x 3.55 m fitting closely, "ENTRY" at bottom, wall section 100 mm. Do not draw enormous gaps around car.
LOWER CENTRE: compact STACK SECTION diagram with three marks "1F 0.00 m", "2F 4.50 m", "RF 9.00 m", one vertical "9.00 m TRAVEL" arrow. Opaque lower storey, glass middle storey, opaque RF head-house above roof. Head-house top at 13.50 m. Caption "RF cap within 4.50 m head-house". No fourth stop.
LOWER RIGHT: magnified cap and portal weather-lip section details, three leaders "140 mm rounded cap", "30 mm shadow reveal", "No footprint overhang".
Footer: "SHAFT 4.00 x 4.00 m  |  WALLS 0.10 m  |  FLOORS 0.00 / 4.50 / 9.00 m  |  DIMENSIONS GOVERN PERSPECTIVE".
Palette: pearl #F4F8F8 softly radiused gloss, brushed silver #C8D2D9, restrained chrome, clear glass with frosted aqua #C6E9E6 / #8FDCE0 edge and ribbon, aqua #45BFC7 small controls, mist #A8BFD1, navy #111B38 smoked indicator/reveal, red #C7473E ONLY fictional AONAGI logo dot.
Avoid: cylindrical shaft, fishbowl car, bubbles, plants, people, real brands, sci-fi greeble, gaudy glow, red controls, pink, vaporwave, dirt, exposed hoisting machinery. Recognisable precision portal and cyan RF indicator, generous soft corner highlights like approved furniture.
references: User attachments: lift_views and lift_pieces for existing form/use; approved props sheets 6/2/5 and concept_L1_A for style only

tries.purpose: Correct only Japanese OPEN/CLOSE labels in try 2
tries.prompt: Edit the supplied AONAGI SHEET 02 / CAR concept sheet. Make one precise correction only: in the large CAR OPERATING PANEL detail at upper right, the Japanese labels under the two small door-control buttons are reversed. The LEFT control must read exactly "開 /" above "OPEN" (開 means open). The RIGHT control must read exactly "閉 /" above "CLOSE" (閉 means close). Preserve the English words OPEN and CLOSE, their positions, both round button icons, all floor buttons, all artwork, dimensions, layout, materials, logo, small in-car panel, captions and all other text exactly as supplied. Do not change the car, rails, door pair, lighting, or any other region. Retain the same landscape canvas, pixel size and finished catalogue style.
